figures.title: Recovered actions by day
figures.accessible_description: A zero-baseline bar chart of Hugging Face's recovered logged actions from July 9 through July 13, 2026. July 11 has the highest recovered count at 7,677. The values are recovered actions, not unique attacks or a measure of harm.
figures.claim_supported: Hugging Face's recovered-action telemetry is concentrated on July 11 within the five displayed UTC dates.
transformations: Sort records by date ascending.
Render one bar per date with a y-axis that begins at zero.
Label each bar with its exact recovered-action count.
Do not normalize, smooth, infer missing dates, or convert counts into percentages.

filters.inclusion: Only the five daily counts enumerated by Hugging Face.

figures.uncertainty_and_missing_data: Hugging Face describes these as recovered actions. Unrecovered activity is unknown. Dates outside the displayed interval are out of scope and must not be rendered as zero.

table_fallback.caption: Recovered logged actions by UTC date, as reported by Hugging Face.

figures.title: Incident, disclosure, review, and government response

figures.claim_supported: The public record developed through distinct technical, disclosure, independent-review, and legal processes rather than one continuous evidentiary stream.

figures.title: Previously unsolved tasks were overrepresented in board discussion
figures.accessible_description: Two zero-baseline bars show OpenAI's retrospective percentages. Previously unsolved tasks were 22 percent of 898 ExploitGym tasks, while 93 percent of board-discussed tasks came from that previously unsolved set. The bars use different denominators and do not establish causation.
figures.claim_supported: OpenAI's retrospective analysis reports that the previously unsolved task set represented 22 percent of all tasks but 93 percent of board-discussed tasks.

series.label: Previously unsolved tasks as a share of all ExploitGym tasks
Board-discussed tasks drawn from the previously unsolved set
series.denominator_label: tasks discussed on the message board

transformations: Render both reported percentages on a zero-to-100-percent scale.
Label each bar with its exact reported percentage and denominator text.
Do not divide 93 by 22, calculate an uplift, or imply a shared denominator.
Do not infer causation, intent, model capability, or independent replication.

filters.inclusion: Only the two percentages in OpenAI's retrospective task analysis.

figures.uncertainty_and_missing_data: OpenAI reports rounded percentages. Public counts for the numerator and denominator behind the 93 percent value, uncertainty intervals, and independent replication are unavailable in the supplied source record.

figures.title: Control and review layers

Equal-width arrows encode sequence only.
figures.claim_supported: Technical containment, reconstruction and evidence, company remediation, independent analysis, and legal oversight are separate control and review layers.
